_comment: Frame spec for the onboarding slide imagery. Raw screenshots live in design/onboarding/raw/ and are composited into public/onboarding/ by scripts/build_onboarding_frames.py. `crop` is [x, y, width, height] in source pixels, or null for the whole image. Slides with `passthrough` reuse an existing asset as-is and are not rebuilt.
_panelNote: The modal paints the image panel the same mint (background, below) and uses object-contain, so the frame edge is invisible and the screenshot is never cropped.

slides.note: Existing mint-green robot animation, kept as-is per request.
